objective: Implement and validate one fail-closed, version-pinned TED eForms XML parser profile that emits deterministic non-personal Candidate Claims without activating source or canonical authority.
outcome: ContractNotice subtype 16 under eForms SDK 1.14 is parsed with hardened XML handling, explicit required and optional fields, buyer-reference resolution, personal-field exclusion and deterministic Candidate Claim fingerprints against synthetic and official SDK examples.

skills.activation_reason: Implement the canonical XML retrieval and parser boundary after Search API discovery.
Map the version-pinned eForms structure to the accepted procurement ontology.
Ensure parser outputs remain Candidate Claims and cannot create canonical truth.
Count but never emit natural-person contact fields from official examples.
Enforce payload limits, safe XML parsing, exact profile checks and pinned-source allowlisting.
Prove deterministic extraction, drift rejection and official-example compatibility.
Keep parser evidence separate from source admission and runtime activation.

external: TED Developer Docs eForms SDK 1.14 schema and notice information

prohibited_scope: Other document types, subtypes or SDK versions
Persistent official notice values or notice identifiers in CI artifacts
Personal contact fields in Candidate Claims, prompts, analytics or exports
Navigator, ResearchRun, Globe or Graph integration

acceptance_evidence.description: Versioned parser profile pins SDK 1.14.2, customization eforms-sdk-1.14, UBL 2.3, ContractNotice, cn-standard and subtype 16.
Synthetic fixture tests extraction, optional unknowns, deterministic fingerprints, personal-field exclusion and fail-closed profile drift.

Pinned official SDK 1.14.2 example parsed transiently: 17 unique Candidate Claims, two organisations, one lot, three personal-field elements observed, zero personal values emitted, zero model calls and zero canonical writes.
defusedxml, DTD/entity rejection, exact profile checks, size limit and URL allowlist pass.
Parser runbook records exact authority, versioning, privacy, evidence and rollback boundaries.

traces: official SDK example download to transient parser
XML source path to Candidate Claim fingerprint

rollback.strategy: Remove the parser from all execution paths, retain raw hashes and synthetic fixtures, quarantine outputs from the profile and preserve the previous Search API-only technical-probe state.
rollback.kill_switch: ted-eforms-cn16@0.1.0 remains absent from production runtime wiring and accepts only one exact profile.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The parser moves discovery from Search API projection to complete official evidence.
Raw hashes, XML source paths, SDK version and deterministic fingerprints preserve provenance.
Extracted geography, organisations, lots and notice timing support future Globe, Graph and Timeline parity.
The parser has no user-interest input and cannot infer truth from attention.
Localised text preserves each source language explicitly.
Versioned raw evidence and deterministic claim fingerprints create reusable state beyond generic AI.
No suitability, advice, bid execution or transaction behaviour is added.
Personal fields are counted for audit but never emitted, persisted or used as evidence.
Exact version gates and absent runtime wiring provide immediate disabling and rollback.
This task is the explicitly authorised dependency before deterministic procurement admission.
